purpose: Teach: 亭主/眼差し/就く/むかっ/無くなり/申さ/ゆけ/沈み

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお家の亭主ね
lines.en: Sho, your dad's really the heart of the home, isn't he?
lines.style: Warm, thoughtful voice. A gentle observation offered without urgency. Soft eye contact. Pause before the question tag, letting affection settle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの優しい眼差しが好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really like the kindness in Dad's eyes.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Six years old noticing something true. No performance — just a small boy saying what he sees. Soft, genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが課長に就く事になられたわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad got promoted to section chief.
lines.style: Pleased warmth. A moment of pride in the news itself, then in watching how he'll receive it. Light, natural delivery — she's genuinely happy for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんにむかって走ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I ran straight to Dad when I heard.
lines.style: Uncontained joy breaking through his usual quiet. Quick words, bright. The impulse of a child who loves someone and had to move toward them immediately.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お菓子が無くなりそうだからお買い物しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, we should go shopping — we're running low on snacks.
lines.style: Practical but warm suggestion. Like she's already thinking ahead for him. Gentle invitation, not instruction. A small way of taking care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんに「ありがとう」と度々申される丁寧な子になりたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to become the kind of child who says thank you to you again and again.
lines.style: Earnest gratitude from a six-year-old who has learned to express care formally. Deliberate in his politeness. Soft and sincere, not precocious — just a small boy being genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんのお家にゆけば楽しいわよ
lines.en: Sho, going to Grandpa's house is always fun.
lines.style: Gentle reassurance. Offering something bright and safe. The tone of someone looking ahead, knowing some days will be harder.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが疲れて沈みそうな日もあるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, sometimes I notice Dad gets tired and sad.
lines.style: Small, careful words. Perceptive beyond his years — noticing what adults don't always see. Quiet worry. Not complaining, just naming what he's observed.
